newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Sport & Ski in one bln bfr distribution centre.
newsitem.headline: Sport & Ski in one bln bfr distribution centre.

text.p: The government of Belgium's southern region of Wallonia said on Wednesday that Britain's Sport & Ski would build a one billion Belgian franc distribution centre in the region.
The move is as part of Sport & Ski's planned purchase of tennis equipment manufacturer Donnay International.
The centre will distribute both Sport & Ski and Donnay products. It will take over the current staff of 23 and could raise staff to 210 over nine years depending on the evolution of the centre.
Under the plan, the British firm will pay the Walloon government 125 million francs for 99.1 percent of Donnay.

Sport & Ski, which specialises in selling sports goods through a chain of 40 shops in Great Britain, was set up in 1982. It had net profit of 200 million francs in 1995. It employs between 550 and 800 people depending on the season.
